lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Wéi, qǐngwèn Wáng Míng zài ma?
lines.english: Hello, may I ask if Wang Ming is there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 他是我同事。他在开会，稍等一下。
lines.pinyin: Tā shì wǒ tóngshì. Tā zài kāihuì, shāo děng yīxià.
lines.english: He's my colleague. He's in a meeting, wait a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 好的，我不挂。麻烦告诉他李华找他。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒ bù guà. Máfan gàosu tā Lǐ Huá zhǎo tā.
lines.english: OK, I'll hold. Please tell him Li Hua is looking for him.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 没问题。您留个电话号码吗？
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Nín liú ge diànhuà hàomǎ ma?
lines.english: No problem. Would you leave a phone number?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 记下了。会让他尽快回电话。
lines.pinyin: Jì xià le. Huì ràng tā jǐnkuài huí diànhuà.
lines.english: Noted. Will have him call back ASAP.
